items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Funds India Lung Cancer Screening Research Beyond Smoking
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) is funding lung cancer screening research in India that targets risks beyond smoking. The Bristol Myers Squibb Foundation is backing two clinical trials at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi. The projects aim to build localized lung cancer risk models and screening tools that include nonsmokers and people exposed to high air pollution.
